In the run up to the '''[[2019 Indian general election|Indian general election, 2019]]''', various organisations carried out '''opinion polls''' to gauge voting intention in [[India]]. Results of such polls are displayed in this article. The date range for these opinion polls are from the Jan 2018 to April 2019.  Many organisations have gone on to conduct exit polls and post-poll surveys as well, which too are displayed.

==Background==
Opinion polls in India can be controversial. These charges include partisan manipulation.<ref>[https://thediplomat.com/2014/02/in-indias-national-election-dont-trust-the-polls/ "In India's National Election, Don't Trust the Polls, Jonah Force Hill, February 24, 2014"]. TheDiplomat.com. Feb 2014.</ref>

Opinion poll methodology has heavily improved and agencies like CSDS have got it absolutely correct on 16 occasions, roughly correct on 7 occasions and wrong on 4 occasions.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.thehinducentre.com/verdict/commentary/article5739722.ece|title=Power and Limitations of Opinion Polls: My Experiences|first=Rajeeva|last=Karandikar|website=The Hindu Center|date=2 April 2014 |access-date=20 March 2019}}</ref>

Post-poll surveys or Exit polls, widely published, are fundamentally different from opinion polls.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/news/national/what-exit-polls-are-really-about/article20769785.ece1|title=What exit polls are really about|website=@businessline|date=12 May 2014 |access-date=20 March 2019}}</ref>

== Opinion polls ==
<section begin=Opinion polling /><!--This is necessary so that this section can be transcluded to [[2019 Indian general election]] – please do not remove-->[[File:Opinion_polling_for_the_2019_Indian_general_election.svg|right|thumb|500px|upright=1.8|Number of seats projected in opinion polls per alliance over time.]]
[[File:IndianGeneralElectionTrend.jpg|thumb|500px|Indian General Election Trends - 2019]]

Various organisations carried out [[opinion polling]] to gauge voting intentions in India. The results of such polls are displayed in this list. The date range for these opinion polls is from the [[2014 Indian general election|previous general election]], held in April and May 2014, to the present day. The ECI banned the release of [[exit poll]]s from 11 April to 19 May, the last phase of the elections.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.uniindia.com/election-commission-bans-exit-poll/die/news/1559180.html|title=Election Commission bans Exit Polls|date=10 April 2019|work=[[United News of India]]|access-date=11 April 2019}}</ref> The commission also banned the publication or broadcast in the media of predictions made by astrologers and tarot card readers.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.businesstoday.in/lok-sabha-elections-2019/news/predicting-election-results-by-astrologers-tarot-card-others-violation-of-law-ec-to-media/story/335429.html|title=Predicting election results by astrologers, tarot card, others violation of law: EC to media|date=9 April 2019|work=Business Today|access-date=11 April 2019}}</ref><section begin="Opinionpolltable" />
